fact: The PAG 2021-2026 was presented to ministry staff on 6 January 2022, listing the high and very high speed internet deployment (phase 2) among seven digital projects, with total sector investment of 346 billion FCFA over five years.
title: PAG 2021-2026 : 07 projets et 04 réformes pour le compte du secteur du numérique et de la digitalisation
